_README: THE WHOLE CLIENT LIVES IN THIS FILE. An Orbilynk client site is a CONFIGURATION, not a rebuild. Any fact shaped { value, ask } with value:null is UNFILLED and renders as a visible placeholder on the page. Run `npm run placeholders` for the list to send the client. ONE FACT, ONE SOURCE: the pages, the schema, the sitemap and the bot dictionary all read THIS file and nothing else.

tagline.ask: One line under the school name, in the school's own words (e.g. 'Where little friends grow'). Max 60 characters.

logo.ask: Logo file, SVG or PNG with a transparent background, at least 400px wide.

domain.ask: The live domain for the school (e.g. bellafriendspreschool.com). Until it is set, canonical URLs use the preview host and the site is noindex.

phone.ask: The phone number a parent should call, exactly as it should be printed.

email.ask: The email address enquiries should reach.

whatsapp.ask: WhatsApp number, with country code, if the school uses WhatsApp. Say 'none' if it does not.

hours.ask: Opening hours, per day (e.g. Mon-Fri 6:30am-6:00pm). Needed for Google and for the page.

contact._HOURS_SPEC_NOTE: WE fill this from her plain answer above - she never learns our format. Google's LocalBusiness page RECOMMENDS openingHoursSpecification objects, not a free-text string. Empty = no hours in the schema, which is correct until she answers. Shape: [{"days":["Monday","Tuesday","Wednesday","Thursday","Friday"],"opens":"06:30","closes":"18:00"}]

role.ask: Brittany's title as it should appear (Owner, Director, Founder...).

licence.ask: NC DCDEE licence number, exactly as printed on the certificate. This is the single strongest trust fact on the page and no competitor we audited publishes it.

starRating.ask: NC star-rated licence, if the school holds one, as the certificate words it.

yearsOpen.ask: The year the school opened. We print the year, never a 'X years of experience' claim we cannot source.

ratios.ask: Teacher-to-child ratio for each age group, as the school actually staffs it. No competitor we audited states one.

credentials.ask: Staff qualifications you want named (e.g. 'all lead teachers hold an NC Early Childhood Credential'). Only what is true and checkable.

insurance.ask: Anything else a parent checks: CPR/First Aid certification, background checks, security system. One line each.

campuses.name: Main campus
campuses._ADDRESS_NOTE: SPLIT ON PURPOSE 2026-11-23. Google's own LocalBusiness page (developers.google.com/search/docs/appearance/structured-data/local-business, opened that day) makes `address` a REQUIRED property and says to include as many sub-properties as possible. A single free-text line cannot produce addressLocality or postalCode, and the CITY is also what the page title and the <h1> eyebrow say - with it empty the title degraded to the whole state of North Carolina.

street.ask: Street address of the school, exactly as the post office has it (number, street, suite if any).
street._source: FROM Spicy-Agency-Hub/lib/presets.js key `bellafriends`, opened 2026-11-24. Our own world, not invented. Confirm with Brittany before launch.

city.ask: The town or city. This one word is the most valuable on the whole site: it is in the page title, the first line a parent reads, and every Google local result.
city._source: FROM Spicy-Agency-Hub/lib/presets.js key `bellafriends`, opened 2026-11-24. Our own world, not invented. Confirm with Brittany before launch.

zip.ask: ZIP code of the school, five digits. Google uses it to decide which parents see you.
zip._source: FROM Spicy-Agency-Hub/lib/presets.js key `bellafriends`, opened 2026-11-24. Our own world, not invented. Confirm with Brittany before launch.

mapQuery.ask: If the Google Maps pin differs from the street address, paste the exact search text.

campuses._GEO_NOTE: Latitude and longitude, 5+ decimal places, which Google RECOMMENDS. Not asked of the school and never guessed: it is read off the Google Business Profile once that exists. Shape: {"lat": 36.07264, "lng": -79.79198}

blurb.ask: 2-3 sentences about the Infants room, in the school's voice.

capacity.ask: How many infant places the school has, if you want it shown.

blurb.ask: 2-3 sentences about Pre-K and kindergarten readiness.
2-3 sentences about the after-school programme. Say 'not offered' if the school does not run one.

tuition._NOTE: Primrose and Goddard both publish NO tuition (opened 2026-11-23). We publish no number we were not given. These fields are optional and stay off the page while null.

from.ask: Only if the school WANTS prices public: the weekly rate per age group. Leave as 'no' to keep tuition behind the enquiry form, which is what the national chains do.

depositPolicy.ask: Registration fee or deposit, and whether it is refundable.

photos._NOTE: Every slot renders a sized, labelled placeholder until a real file arrives. We never put a stock photo on a school page and let a parent think it is their child's classroom.

hero.ask: One wide photo for the top of the page: real children in the real room, landscape, at least 1600px wide.

rooms.ask: One photo per program room (Infants, Toddlers, Preschool, Pre-K, After School). Landscape, at least 1200px wide.

outside.ask: One photo of the playground or the entrance a parent will recognise on arrival.

team.ask: A photo of Brittany and, if they agree, the lead teachers.

reviews._NOTE: NOT INVENTED. Nothing renders here until the school sends real, attributable reviews or connects its Google profile.

googlePlaceId.ask: The Google Business Profile link for the school, so reviews come from Google and never from us.

destination.ask: WHERE EVERY FORM SUBMISSION MUST LAND: which inbox, and which phone for the text alert. This is written down the moment the form is built - no form ships without a destination.

tourSlots.ask: Which days and times the school can take tours, so the form offers real slots instead of 'we will be in touch'.

integrations._leadStoreNOTE: file = writes to .data/leads.json on this deployment and shows in /admin. 'supabase' is wired in lib/leadStore.js but OFF: it needs a project and keys, which only Spicy sets. NOT CONFIGURED.

analytics.ask: Google Analytics / Search Console access, when the domain is live.
